OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t,
  CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t,
  CASE
    WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
    ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y')
  END AS birth_date
WITH p, t,
  2026 - CAST(DATE_PART('year', birth_date) AS INT64) - CASE
    WHEN CAST(DATE_PART('month', birth_date) AS INT64) > 10
      OR (CAST(DATE_PART('month', birth_date) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(DATE_PART('day', birth_date) AS INT64) > 14)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS age
WHERE (age < 42 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <= 1)
   OR (t.team_name = 'Detroit Pistons' AND p.college = 'Temple University')
RETURN p.college AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player
